gestureos — technical digest
===========================

Multi-screen eye & gesture computer control — cursor, click, scroll, drag and media control driven by camera (MediaPipe)

## Key configuration

license: LICENSE
name: gestureos

## Modules

.claude/ape/ape_hook.py
benchmarks/__init__.py
benchmarks/latency.py — Runnable latency harness — `make bench` / `python -m benchmarks.latency`.
core/__init__.py — core — modality-agnostic foundation shared by every input modality.
core/bus.py — Asyncio pub/sub bus for fan-out, plus a synchronous fast-path for the hot loop.
core/events.py — Core event schemas flowing perception -> context -> resolution -> action.
core/protocols.py — Typed structural interfaces every concrete implementation must satisfy.
core/types.py — Core value types — modality-agnostic identifiers and configuration.
gestureos/__init__.py — gestureos — Multi-screen eye & gesture computer control.
gestureos/__main__.py — Entry point for `python -m gestureos`.
gestureos/cli.py — gestureos command-line interface.
gestureos/perf.py — Latency measurement primitives for the perception -> action pipeline.
scripts/quality_gate.py
tests/__init__.py
tests/fakes.py — Fake modality consumers used to prove the core path is modality-neutral.
tests/test_benchmark.py — Smoke test for the runnable latency harness on the no-op backend.
tests/test_core_contract.py — Contract tests: prove the core path is modality-neutral and the bus behaves.
tests/test_perf.py — Tests for the latency measurement primitives.
tests/test_smoke.py — Bootstrap smoke tests — keep the package importable and CLI wired.
